hook: OpenAI's o1 just out-diagnosed ER doctors in a Harvard triage trial.
narration: OpenAI's o1 just out-diagnosed ER doctors in a Harvard triage trial. In the study, o1 correctly diagnosed 67% of emergency room patients. Human triage doctors landed between 50 and 55% on the same charts, same vitals, same intake notes. The base model wasn't even fine-tuned for medicine. Triage is the highest-stakes 90 seconds in medicine — a wrong call sends a stroke patient to the waiting room for hours. A 12-point accuracy gap means hospitals will pilot models like o1 as a second reader, not a replacement. EHR vendors are racing to wire it in. Malpractice insurers will price the gap in either way. Residents training today will graduate into a workflow where the model reads the chart first, and the human signs off. Expect the FDA, not OpenAI, to set the pace from here.
